Vote - DEFER - Lines 23, 29, 31 and 34 should stay as I fixed them at finalization. BL XII 59 picks up my suggestions in JJP 30 (2000) 26, but they were not as clear-cut as made to look in BL, and to prioritise ὄργ(ου) (singular) in lin23, where two toponyms are mentioned, would be wrong. Twenty years later, I think that ὀργ(άνων) of ed. pr. is viable, and for this reason I put it first, with (was I think was) my suggestion in second place (apparatus).
